- sync disabled

Documentation:

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable: human review, no executable operation.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

## PR #847 remediation scope (zaq-e5z)

Reused completed-feature UX approval gate for zaq-e5z. Newly blocked by zaq-e5z.10; preserve all historical prerequisites. The user's agreement to the remediation plan is NOT approval of completed UX and does not close this gate.
Review the actual implemented WhatsApp journey: QR scan still displays phone and available name; same saved account on relink; non-super-admin enable denied with no state/runtime/QR effect; super-admin enable succeeds or clearly reports runtime pending; saved account with failed activation can Disable/Delete without a listener; cleanup failure is visible and retryable; other account unaffected; close/retry/expiry and polling behavior preserved. No live device access or real messages without separate authorization.
Record approver, exact revision, date and message/review source once explicit approval is given. Reopen for material UX changes. Until then do not author/expand new E2E journeys in zaq-0l7.8; immediate unit/integration/LiveView/property tests and running existing E2E remain allowed. Tests/mocking: human review gate, no production changes; use existing offline demo/fixtures. Documentation: this issue's approval evidence. Action reuse: not applicable, no executable operation.
